persistence_model: Two durable files (approval store + plan ledger) with write-ahead ordered reservation under an exclusive OS file lock. Ordering: accept (validate approval record + recompute binding digest) -> fault(BeforePlanReserve) -> durably reserve plan_id (Reserved phase) -> fault(AfterPlanReserve) -> fault(BeforeApprovalConsume) -> durably consume approval -> fault(AfterApprovalConsume) -> fault(BeforeSpawn) -> spawn.
atomicity_analysis: Two atomic renames are not one transaction, so the implementation uses fail-closed ordered reservation instead: after step 1 a crash leaves the plan reserved (no replay); after step 2 the plan stays reserved and the approval stays consumed; the ledger write-ahead records the phase before the next step. Availability loss is accepted; double effect is not possible.

fault_points.phase: after acceptance validation, before durable reservation
fault_points.crash_result: no durable reservation, no consumption; approval remains usable only for the exact same plan; a replay attempt re-enters the same fail-closed path
plan durably reserved; restart rejects any second execution of the same plan
plan reserved; approval not yet consumed but cannot be used by any other plan (binding digest + plan_id match required)
plan reserved + approval consumed; restart blocks replay

fault_points.phase: durable state committed, spawn about to start
fault_points.crash_result: plan reserved + approval consumed; spawn failure or crash never unreserves/unconsumes; retry requires a new plan and a new approval

concurrency.same_plan_concurrent_attempts: 8/16/32 threads => exactly 1 accepted (counter assertion), others rejected
concurrency.multi_broker_same_store: second Broker instance on the same store opens degraded; exclusive OS lock (LockFileEx/flock) serializes writers
concurrency.cross_process_guarantee: Fail-closed exclusive OS lock + single-instance authority assumption. Documented enforceability: no lock-free cross-process claim is made beyond the fail-closed lock.

corruption_matrix.result: FAIL_CLOSED (exactly one reservation wins under lock)
IMPOSSIBLE: corrupt ledger degrades, never resets

store_policy.production_path: Tauri app-data / trusted configured root (not the repository working tree); caller cannot choose the path
store_policy.permissions_note: No store file is written inside the repository; all tests use temp dirs
